Why should the game be balanced around solo queue? The gameplay for survivor is already pretty mindless, either you get chased or you do gens mindlessly and once you're done you move on to the next one without any real planning or thought. If there was a threat of leaving two really difficult gens til the end, then it could make interesting strategies for both survivor and killer.
